title: What tonation means
summary: Albert explains tone terms such as a pea-shooter sound versus a big round tone.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Lips, teeth and breath: the physical craft of brass playing

blocks.x: Tonation is that that you get out of the horns. Like some fellas say, well man his tone sounds like a pea shooter. Another guy says he has a tone bigger round as an apple. Well here's what that means. If a guy plays a horn and he has a light sound coming out, well that's a pea shooter sound. You know you play your own sound like, Alright then if he hears a great big sound like, Look, you say that's a sound as big around as a bowl. Because it's beautiful. It has a space that it's covered. And a pea shooter doesn't cover too much space.
